title: Modules courbes elliptiques en caractéristiques ≠2 : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: S is a base with residue characteristics ≠ 2, and X/S is a P^1-bundle (a conic). On the previous page Grothendieck proved a local normal form. Étale-locally, a fibrewise monomorphic action of the Klein four-group V ≅ (F_2)^2 on P^1_S is given by σ1: z ↦ -z, σ2: z ↦ 1/z, σ3: z ↦ -1/z. Their fixed-point divisors are Δ1 = {0,∞}, Δ2 = {1,-1}, Δ3 = {i,-i}. The disjoint union Δ = Δ1 ⊔ Δ2 ⊔ Δ3 is an étale divisor of degree 6, the 'octahedral configuration' attached to the action.

This page:
(i) Defines an octahedral configuration in X/S in general: an étale degree-6 divisor that is étale-locally isomorphic to {0,∞,±1,±i} ⊂ P^1_S. Equivalently, it is étale-locally the configuration of some monomorphic action of a group scheme V locally isomorphic to the constant Klein group.
(ii) Announces that the V-action, and the structure carried by Δ, are essentially unique given Δ.
(iii) Introduces Γ = Aut_S(X,Δ) (17), the group scheme of automorphisms of X/S preserving Δ. Since deg Δ ≥ 3 and PGL_2 acts freely on ordered triples, Γ embeds in G_Δ = Aut_S(Δ), which is finite étale and locally the constant S_6. Hence Γ is finite and unramified over S. Checking the local model, Γ is étale and locally isomorphic to (S_4)_S, the rotation group of the octahedron with vertices 0,∞,±1,±i on the Riemann sphere.
(iv) Plans to put on Δ a structure of 'scheme of combinatorial octahedra' (in the sense of schemes of sets) such that Γ = Aut^+_oct(Δ) (18), the direct (orientation-preserving) octahedral automorphisms, as subschemes of Aut_S(Δ).
(v) Observes that on a 6-element set an octahedral structure is determined by its group of direct automorphisms inside S_Δ.

The next page completes (v). The three 'diagonals' Δ_i are the classes of points having the same isotropy group, cyclic of order 4. The 12 edges are the 2-element subsets not equal to a diagonal, and the 8 faces are the sections of Δ → Δ/R. Hence the structure is unique and its existence is a local question.

Purpose: a stack-theoretic, relative-over-S treatment of level structures for the moduli of elliptic curves in characteristic ≠ 2. The six points are classically the images in E/{±1} ≅ P^1 of the points P with 2P = t for t a nonzero 2-torsion point, i.e. E[4] \ E[2] mod ±1. They are the fixed points of the translations by E[2] acting on the x-line.
errors: No mathematical error. 'Γ is étale and locally isomorphic to S_4' is stated as 'immediate', but it needs the local-model computation that the stabilizer of {0,∞,±1,±i} in PGL_2 has order exactly 24 on every fibre. This holds also in characteristic 3, where the stabilizer equals that of the complementary 4-set P^1(F_9) \ Δ, which has j = 0 = 1728 and stabilizer S_4. Finiteness and unramifiedness do follow at once from deg Δ ≥ 3.

ideas.what: Relative notion of an octahedral configuration: an étale degree-6 divisor in a P^1-bundle, étale-locally isomorphic to {0,∞,±1,±i}, equivalently the fixed-point divisor of a monomorphic Klein-group action
ideas.modern_name: octahedral (S_4) configuration / twisted forms of the octahedral point set on a conic
ideas.usually_credited_to: Klein (classical octahedral group, Vorlesungen über das Ikosaeder 1884); relative form folklore

ideas.what: Γ = Aut_S(X,Δ) is finite étale, locally (S_4)_S, embedded in Aut_S(Δ) because PGL_2 acts freely on triples
ideas.modern_name: finite étale automorphism group scheme of a marked conic; binary/octahedral subgroup of PGL_2

ideas.what: Encoding the octahedral structure on a 6-point étale scheme by its direct automorphism group, or by the equivalence relation 'same cyclic isotropy of order 4' (diagonals), giving Γ = Aut^+_oct(Δ)
ideas.modern_name: schemes of combinatorial structures / twisted forms classified by H^1(S, S_4); reconstruction of a polyhedral structure from its rotation group

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but routine relative-scheme rendering of Klein's octahedral configuration and the S_4 symmetry of the fixed points of a Klein-four action on P^1, set up for level-2/level-4 moduli of elliptic curves. It is pedagogically nice in Grothendieck's 'schemes of combinatorial structures' style but contains nothing a specialist would find new.
transcription_corrections: 'à une q. {+monom.+}' should read 'à une op[ération] monom[orphique]' (the inserted word 'monom.' sits under 'op.').
In the margin insertion the image reads '(du fait que Δ ⊂ ... est de degré ≥3)' with 'Γ ⊂ G_Δ = Aut_S(Δ)' written above. The transcription's placement is approximately right.
'que Γ est {+fini+} sur S, [?] et que Γ est étale' — the image reads 'que Γ est fini sur S, et loc. isom. au schéma en groupes (S_4)_S', with 'étale' on the following line ('que Γ est étale sur S').
'(comme schéma des ensembles)' is better read as '(comme schéma des ensembles)' attached to 'structure d'octaèdre', i.e. 'une structure d'octaèdre (comme schéma d'ensembles)'.

'on [-note que une diviseur [?] une-] structure octaédrale' — the crossed-out phrase is roughly 'note qu'une donnée d'une'; the retained text is 'on [note qu'une] structure octaédrale sur un ens. à six éléments est bien déterminée ...'.
